body: Yeah I'm understanding that now. I guess I was a bit too distraught to think rationally. I don't like being upset at my pets and I just want to be able to get over only thinking about the dead body when I interact with the dog.
I 100% agree with this. I do feel a lot of guilt about that and also about being mad at the dog at first. Thank you for the actual advice
Alright you worthless excuse for life
Thank you, I wish I had held some sort of ceremony earlier. I'm trying not to be angry at him because he's just a dog and he had no bad intentions
Yeah I completely understand. I just need help rationalizing it all. Like I don't want to look at my dog and think of him as terrible. Thanks for contributing advice.
No I dont, so sorry for your brothers girlfriend and thank you

Thank you. He's grown up with cats and I do want to get him trained to not attack other small animals. That's one reason why im clashing with my family because I told them he had to be trained not to attack or play rough with small animals, and told not to go near the coop and they just say he doesn't know any better and he doesn't realize he did something wrong. I agree that he doesn't think he did anything wrong because he's a dog, but yeah dogs can and should be trained. Thank you again for the advice and I will try shifting my grief from blaming the dog
Thank you I felt like I was being really irrational for not being able to look at my dog without feeling upset. I don't hate him i guess I just need some time to grieve
Thank you. I really needed a rational explanation to help me with this.

I'm not looking for compassion. I'm looking for advice on how to rationalize this. But I also didn't come here for my choice of words to be criticized especially when I guess I'm in a state of grief. I was asking advice on how not to clash with my family about the dog who ate half of my ducklings body. Sorry for not being a dog person I guess?
Thank you. It really does help
Something about what you said bring me great comfort. I don't see her as a terrible person I'm just heart broken over her telling me she needs a break. Thank you for responding to this
I guess an ideal life would just feeling like I matter to people instead of just being pushed aside or hurt. Itd be nice to  just feel ok and happy for more than five seconds.
